scope: Broaden current open-source DWG/DXF route research to newer CAD/viewer applications, identify the actual parser and converter lineages, and update the existing optional comparator plan without adding required tests or promoting support.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source review of project documentation, manifests, npm metadata, and issue reports, reconciled against the existing peer matrix
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: current optional DXF-reader candidates, parser-lineage rules, CADCraft/ACadRust entries, and composed consumer checkpoint
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing large-document/resource-safety owners and 3D carrier/ACIS/AcDs evidence gates
method.limitations: Mutable repository pages and package metadata establish declared dependencies and project scope, not executable conformance. The MLightCAD DXF converter source was not source-audited or run, and exact npm tarball-to-source correspondence was not resolved. MLightCAD issue #619's drawing was not available to this review.

routeFindings.observed: The current npm page lists @mlightcad/data-model 1.15.8. Project documentation identifies an MIT built-in AcDbNativeDxfConverter registered by default and describes it as streaming DXF into an AutoCAD-like database. The public documentation does not establish exact ASCII/Binary coverage, unknown-record retention, raw carrier preservation, graph closure, or 3D semantics.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: Optional candidate for direct DXF structural comparison only; exact package/source binding and parser lineage remain unaudited. No DWG evidence follows from this converter.
routeFindings.planUse: Consider as an alternative—not an additional run—to already-listed undxf/other candidates at the existing composed comparator checkpoint. Pin npm integrity and source revision; confirm exact input-mode support; compare direct parsed fields and unknown/owner disposition to a locally authored manifest.

routeFindings.observed: The public project documentation says DWG loading is opt-in and uses a separate @mlightcad/libredwg-converter based on LibreDWG compiled to WebAssembly. A private @mlightcad/dwg-converter is not present in the public repository/CI and is not available as an open-source route. The maintainer identifies LibreDWG converter OOM as a known limitation in issue #619.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: LibreDWG-lineage application route and peer-reported resource-risk observation; not an independent DWG parser or a reproduced libdxfrw defect. No customer drawing or peer-specific cap is available as an admissible test input/limit.
routeFindings.planUse: Keep within existing LibreDWG lineage and parser resource-admission owners. Do not add the converter as a dependency or introduce external samples/full-suite runs.

routeFindings.observed: CodeCAD's cadview-core manifest declares acadrust = 0.3 and its checked-in Cargo.lock resolves ACadRust 0.3.4 from crates.io. CADCraft's README states that its DWG read/write route uses ACadRust; its own DXF feature/loss matrix is already covered in the plan.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: Separate application packages and possible consumer projections, but no new DWG parser lineage. A product-level successful open or render is not semantic or native acceptance evidence.
routeFindings.planUse: Retain as ACadRust-family applications; record exact app/package/lock when an optional composed consumer test is already warranted. Do not count them as independent parser votes or duplicate CADCraft findings.

routeFindings.observed: The package manifest lists @mlightcad/libredwg-web 0.7.9 and dxf-parser with a fallback. Its README documents browser projection/rendering and partial preview forms such as splines as polylines.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: A downstream app route over the existing LibreDWG and dxf-parser lineages; viewer output does not establish full object graph, carrier, or solid semantics.
routeFindings.planUse: Optional composed deployment/viewer observation only; no additional codec vote, dependency, or routine runtime.

routeFindings.observed: The README documents an explicit DXF subset, including 3DFACE and planar SOLID entities. Its DWG support is marked experimental and directs users to export DWG as DXF.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: DXF subset renderer/consumer only. The documented SOLID and 3DFACE entities do not establish 3DSOLID/ACIS/SAB/AcDs semantics or a native DWG reader.
routeFindings.planUse: Only a trigger-based DXF projection/coordinate observation if a named consumer question warrants it; do not use for DWG or 3D-solid qualification.

ownersRefined: optional direct DXF parser/structural comparator intake
explicit 3D carrier, ACIS/AcDs, and native consumer evidence gates
